name: 가넷
visual_review: 은회색 긴 머리·붉은 눈·가시 방망이의 정체성을 유지했습니다. 사슬 투척, 양손으로 당기는 자세, 아이언 메이든 폐쇄와 회수 단계가 확인됩니다.
motion_summary: Garnet silver-gray long hair, sharp red eyes, black cropped strappy costume and heavy black spiked implement from portrait. Her official R throws a chain to mark and bind a target, then conditionally pulls it into an iron maiden for execution. Show this full two-stage representative sequence. Animate sinister idle; raising spiked weapon behind shoulder; free hand points right; throws a long crimson-black chain to right; pulling the chain back with both hands and leaning back; a small thorn-edged iron maiden coffin opens at right; hard pulling stomp with tilted torso; the iron maiden closes with a sharp red-black flash; recoil weapon swings behind; fading red chains; straighten; original idle. No bloody gore, no victim, no invented ornate throne; abstract spiked execution seal only. Face stays readable.
